module counter_12 
(
  input rst_n,
  input clk,
  input valid_count,

  output reg [3:0] out
);

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  if (!rst_n) begin
    out <= 4'b0000; // Reset the counter to 0
  end else if (valid_count) begin
    if (out == 4'd11) begin
      out <= 4'b0000; // Wrap around to 0 if maximum count is reached
    end else begin
      out <= out + 1; // Increment the counter
    end
  end
end

endmodule

module multi_16bit(
    input clk,          // Chip clock signal.
    input rst_n,        // Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for chip reset; defined as 1 for reset signal inactive.
    input start,        // Chip enable signal. 
    input [15:0] ain,   // Input a (multiplicand) with a data width of 16 bits.
    input [15:0] bin,   // Input b (multiplier) with a data width of 16 bits.

    output [31:0] yout, // Product output with a data width of 32 bits.
    output done         // Chip output flag signal. Defined as 1 indicates multiplication operation completion.
);

    reg [15:0] areg;         // Register to hold multiplicand
    reg [15:0] breg;         // Register to hold multiplier
    reg [31:0] yout_r;       // Register to hold the product
    reg [4:0] i;             // Counter for shifts (5 bits to count up to 16)
    reg done_r;              // Register to hold done flag

    assign yout = yout_r;    // Assign the product register to the output
    assign done = done_r;    // Assign the done flag register to the output

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            areg <= 16'b0;
            breg <= 16'b0;
            yout_r <= 32'b0;
            i <= 5'b0;
            done_r <= 1'b0;
        end else if (start) begin
            if (i == 0) begin
                areg <= ain;           // Load multiplicand
                breg <= bin;           // Load multiplier
                yout_r <= 32'b0;       // Reset product register
                done_r <= 1'b0;        // Reset done flag
                i <= 1;                // Start shift count
            end else if (i <= 16) begin
                if (areg[i-1]) begin
                    yout_r <= yout_r + (breg << (i-1)); // Accumulate partial product
                end
                i <= i + 1;            // Increment shift count
            end else if (i == 17) begin
                done_r <= 1'b1;        // Signal completion
                i <= i + 1;            // Increment to prepare for reset
            end else begin
                done_r <= 1'b0;        // Reset done for next operation
                i <= 0;                // Reset shift count
            end
        end
    end

endmodule

module multi_booth_8bit (p, rdy, clk, reset, a, b);
   input clk, reset;
   input [7:0] a, b;
   output reg [15:0] p;
   output reg rdy;

   reg [15:0] multiplicand, multiplier;
   reg [4:0] ctr;
   reg [1:0] booth_bits;

   always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
      if (reset) begin
         multiplicand <= {{8{a[7]}}, a}; // Sign-extend a to 16 bits
         multiplier <= {{8{b[7]}}, b};   // Sign-extend b to 16 bits
         p <= 16'b0;                     // Clear product register
         rdy <= 0;                       // Clear ready signal
         ctr <= 5'b0;                    // Reset counter
      end else begin
         if (ctr < 8) begin
            booth_bits = {multiplier[ctr], ctr == 0 ? 1'b0 : multiplier[ctr-1]};
            case (booth_bits)
               2'b01: p <= p + multiplicand;   // Add multiplicand
               2'b10: p <= p - multiplicand;   // Subtract multiplicand
               default: p <= p;                // No operation
            endcase
            multiplicand <= multiplicand << 1; // Left shift multiplicand
            ctr <= ctr + 1;                    // Increment counter
         end else begin
            rdy <= 1;                          // Set ready signal
         end
      end
   end
endmodule

module pulse_detect(    
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    input data_in,
    output reg data_out
);

    reg [1:0] state; // 2-bit state register to track four states

    // State definitions
    localparam STATE_IDLE = 2'b00;
    localparam STATE_RISING = 2'b01;
    localparam STATE_FALLING = 2'b10;
    localparam STATE_PULSE = 2'b11;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            state <= STATE_IDLE;  // Reset state to idle
            data_out <= 1'b0;     // Reset output to 0
        end else begin
            case (state)
                STATE_IDLE: begin
                    data_out <= 1'b0; // Ensure output is 0
                    if (data_in) 
                        state <= STATE_RISING; // Rising edge detected
                end

                STATE_RISING: begin
                    if (!data_in) 
                        state <= STATE_FALLING; // Falling edge detected
                end

                STATE_FALLING: begin
                    if (data_in) 
                        state <= STATE_RISING; // Invalid pattern, back to rising
                    else begin
                        state <= STATE_PULSE; // Valid pulse detected
                        data_out <= 1'b1;     // Set output to 1
                    end
                end

                STATE_PULSE: begin
                    data_out <= 1'b0; // Clear output after one cycle
                    state <= STATE_IDLE; // Return to idle state
                end

                default: begin
                    state <= STATE_IDLE; // Default to idle state
                    data_out <= 1'b0;    // Default output
                end
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule

module pulse_detect(    
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    input data_in,
    output reg data_out
);

    reg [1:0] state; // 2-bit state register to track states

    // State Encoding
    localparam IDLE = 2'b00,
               RISING_EDGE = 2'b01,
               FALLING_EDGE = 2'b10,
               PULSE_DETECTED = 2'b11;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            state <= IDLE; // Reset state to IDLE
            data_out <= 0; // Reset output
        end else begin
            case (state)
                IDLE: begin
                    data_out <= 0; // Ensure output is reset
                    if (data_in == 1)
                        state <= RISING_EDGE; // Transition to RISING_EDGE
                end

                RISING_EDGE: begin
                    if (data_in == 0)
                        state <= FALLING_EDGE; // Transition to FALLING_EDGE
                end

                FALLING_EDGE: begin
                    if (data_in == 1)
                        state <= RISING_EDGE; // Invalid pattern, return to RISING_EDGE
                    else begin
                        state <= PULSE_DETECTED; // Valid pattern detected
                        data_out <= 1; // Output pulse
                    end
                end

                PULSE_DETECTED: begin
                    data_out <= 0; // Clear output after pulse
                    state <= IDLE; // Return to IDLE state
                end

                default: begin
                    state <= IDLE; // Default to IDLE state
                    data_out <= 0; // Default output
                end
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule

module pulse_detect(
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    input data_in,
    output reg data_out
);

    reg [1:0] state; // State register to track current state
    reg [1:0] next_state; // Register to determine next state

    // State encoding
    localparam IDLE = 2'b00;
    localparam RISE = 2'b01;
    localparam FALL = 2'b10;
    localparam PULSE = 2'b11;

    // Sequential logic for state transition
    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            state <= IDLE; // Reset state
            data_out <= 1'b0; // Reset output
        end else begin
            state <= next_state; // Update state
            data_out <= (next_state == PULSE); // Generate output signal
        end
    end

    // Combinational logic for next state determination
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            IDLE: begin
                if (data_in) 
                    next_state = RISE; // Rising edge detected
                else 
                    next_state = IDLE; // Remain idle
            end
            RISE: begin
                if (!data_in) 
                    next_state = FALL; // Falling edge detected
                else 
                    next_state = RISE; // Stay in rising edge state
            end
            FALL: begin
                if (data_in) 
                    next_state = RISE; // Invalid pattern, go back to rising edge
                else 
                    next_state = PULSE; // Valid pulse detected
            end
            PULSE: begin
                next_state = IDLE; // Return to idle after pulse detection
            end
            default: begin
                next_state = IDLE; // Default state
            end
        endcase
    end

endmodule

module RAM (
	input clk,
	input rst_n,
	
	input write_en,
	input [7:0]write_addr,
	input [5:0]write_data,
	
	input read_en,
	input [7:0]read_addr,
	output reg [5:0]read_data
);

	reg [5:0] ram [7:0]; // 8 locations, each 6 bits wide
	integer i;

	always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
		if (!rst_n) begin
			// Reset: Initialize all RAM locations to 000000
			for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
				ram[i] <= 6'b000000;
			end
		end else begin
			// Write operation
			if (write_en && write_addr < 8) begin
				ram[write_addr] <= write_data;
			end
		end
	end
